101.Describe: Claim Tier 3 Daily Activity rewards {*val*} time
101.TextAdd: 必修课day1-1-累积领取1次日活第三档宝箱
101.Tips: Adventurers can choose to complete Dungeons, Casual Modes, or Exploration based on their preferences to increase Activity and claim daily rewards. Rewards include current Season EXP, Honor Coins, Bound Rose Orbs, and more!

102.Tips: Unstable Space is a light dungeon mode where you can obtain resources daily. Through Solo/Duo modes, you can easily complete it with the help of Assist NPCs. Missed rewards can be reclaimed next week via the Reclaim Hub.

103.Describe: Consume any amount of Reclaim Tokens
103.TextAdd: 必修课day1-3-嘉年华休闲活动N次
103.Tips: Challenges and rewards missed by adventurers this week can be reclaimed next week via Season Hub - Reclaim Hub. You can prioritize redeeming what you need based on material categories.

104.Describe: Claim Tier 3 Daily Activity rewards {*val*} times
104.TextAdd: 必修课day2-1-累积领取2次日活第三档宝箱
104.Tips: Adventurers can choose to complete Dungeons, Casual Modes, or Exploration based on their preferences to increase Activity and claim daily rewards. Rewards include current Season EXP, Honor Coins, Bound Rose Orbs, and more!

105.TextAdd: 必修课day2-2-极限空间普通1次
105.Tips: Chaotic Realm offers different difficulties with stronger World Boss mechanics and monster abilities! Besides First Clear rewards, every clear offers a chance to get gear, gear enhancement materials, and dungeon-exclusive appearance exchange materials. It is the most important way to obtain gear. Solo/Duo modes will open over time, allowing single players to complete dungeon challenges with Assist NPCs.

106.Describe: Consume any amount of Honor Coins
106.Tips: Obtainable by completing Daily Missions, weekly gameplay, and event opportunities, with a weekly cap of 10,000. Use in Honor Coin to redeem items that boost strength. It is a basic yet important currency in your growth process!

107.Describe: Claim Tier 3 Daily Activity rewards {*val*} times
107.TextAdd: 必修课day3-1-累积领取3次日活第三档宝箱
107.Tips: Gain Activity by completing goals. Accumulate Activity to claim daily rewards. Rewards include current Season EXP, Luno, Honor Coins, Bound Rose Orbs, Season Pass EXP, and more!

108.Describe: Complete the Talent Training Quest "Brought to Justice"
108.TextAdd: 必修课day3-2-完成天赋历练任务哪几个
108.Tips: Go to Asterleeds and find Airona to accept Talent Training Quests. Completing them grants Talent Points. Use the points in the Talent Tree to activate nodes for stat effects, passive effects, or special skill effects, shaping your own combat style.

109.Describe: Consume {*val*} Boss Loot Key(s) and obtain rewards
109.TextAdd: 必修课day3-3-讨伐首领，开箱子1次
109.Tips: Defeat Boss monsters in the wild and use the daily Loot Key to open Loot Chests. You can obtain rich rewards like rare materials used to craft Battle Imagines. Keys can be accumulated for up to 3 days.

110.Describe: Claim Tier 3 Daily Activity rewards {*val*} times
110.TextAdd: 必修课day4-1-累积领取4次日活第三档宝箱
110.Tips: Adventurers can choose to complete Dungeons, Casual Modes, or Exploration based on their preferences to increase Activity and claim daily rewards. Rewards include current Season EXP, Honor Coins, Bound Rose Orbs, and more!

111.Tips: In Life Skills activities, some gathering targets and crafting targets cost Focus. In addition to earning tradable items, you will also gain a large amount of Life Skills EXP. 400 Focus auto-recovers daily at 05:00 (UTC-2), subject to the max Focus limit of 2,000.

112.Tips: Join a Guild and take on cargo quests at the Guild Center to obtain Luno and Guild Tokens! Guild Tokens can be exchanged for refining materials, Focus, dyes, appearances, and more.

113.Describe: Complete the main quest "[S1] Echoes at the Towering Ruin"
113.TextAdd: 必修课day5-1-剧情完成前两话（把巨塔遗迹覆盖一下）
113.Tips: Follow the interface guide to complete the designated Season 1 Main Story Quests. Besides Bound Luno, you can obtain outfit sets, accessories, and other appearance rewards at key story nodes!

114.Describe: Clear Tier 15 of any Class Trial
114.Tips: Trial Path is a stage to verify Class Skills. By choosing the path of power, protection, or support, you can learn the team responsibilities of each class in combat. Completing trials grants exclusive items to boost class talents and proficiency, further enhancing the class experience.

201.QuickJumpIdText: 荣誉币商店、补偿商店、交易中心、神秘商店、装备兑换、20人团本
201.TextAdd: 强度党-进行{*val*}次装备重铸
201.Tips: Reforging is one way to upgrade gear. Go to Maxim at the Artisan Guild for reforging. When dismantling reforged gear, the used materials will be fully refunded. Gear Reforge Stones are obtainable via:

202.QuickJumpIdText: 荣誉币商店、不稳定空间、交易中心、神秘商店、职业材料兑换、怪物讨伐-精英、怪物讨伐-首领、生活职业-铸造、协会杂货铺
202.TextAdd: 强度党-进行{*val*}次装备精炼
202.Tips: Refinement is one way to upgrade gear. Go to Maxim at the Artisan Guild for refinement. When replacing gear of the same slot, refinement will be transferred automatically for free. Gear refinement materials are obtainable via:

203.QuickJumpIdText: 交易中心、生活职业-工艺、印记、怪物讨伐-精英、怪物讨伐-首领
203.TextAdd: 强度党-进行{*val*}次装备镶嵌
203.Tips: Embedding is one way to upgrade gear. Go to Maxim at the Artisan Guild for embedding. Embedding materials are obtainable via:

204.TextAdd: 强度党-参与击败{*val*}次首领怪物
204.Tips: Defeat Boss monsters in the wild and use the daily Loot Key to open Loot Chests. You can obtain rich rewards like rare materials used to craft Battle Imagines. Keys can be accumulated for up to 3 days. Completing goals in the Monster Hunt Manual also grants lots of Bound Rose Orbs.

205.TextAdd: 强度党-参与击败{*val*}次精英怪物
205.Tips: Defeat Elite monsters in the wild and use the daily Loot Key to open Loot Chests. You can obtain rich rewards like rare materials used to craft Battle Imagines. Keys can be accumulated for up to 3 days. Completing goals in the Monster Hunt Manual also grants lots of Bound Rose Orbs.

206.TextAdd: 强度党-参与击败{*val*}次普通怪物
206.Tips: Defeat Normal monsters in the wild to obtain corresponding materials and rewards. Completing goals in the Monster Hunt Manual also grants lots of Bound Rose Orbs.

207.TextAdd: 强度党-通关{*val*}次“不稳定空间”挑战
207.Tips: Unstable Space is a light dungeon mode where you can obtain resources daily. Through Solo/Duo modes, you can easily complete it with the help of Assist NPCs. Missed rewards can be reclaimed next week via the Reclaim Hub.

209.QuickJumpIdText: 不稳定空间、极限空间、协会狩猎、司第门遗迹
209.TextAdd: 强度党-与好友或协会成员组队通关任意副本{*val*}次
209.Tips: You can choose to participate in: Unstable Space, Chaotic Realm, Stimen Vaults, and Guild Hunting.

210.QuickJumpIdText: 协会货运、协会狩猎、协会周活跃奖励
210.TextAdd: 强度党-获得{*val*}个协会贡献币
210.Tips: Participate in Guild activities to earn Guild Tokens. Tokens can be used in the Guild Store to redeem Gear Refinement Materials, Focus Recovery Potions, Dyes, Appearances, etc. Guild Tokens are obtainable via:

211.TextAdd: 角色扮演-更换{*val2*}次时装外观
211.Tips: Besides the Newbie/Returnee Special Operation, there are many ways to get Outfit Appearances for free, such as: S1 Main Story, Reputation Exchange, Friendship Points Exchange, Bound Rose Orbs Exchange, Chaotic Realm Dungeons, Season Title Upgrades, Festival Events, etc. Collect fashionable appearances and dress up in the Wardrobe!

212.TextAdd: 角色扮演-进行{*val*}次时装染色
212.Tips: Go to the Wardrobe and dye your outfits with your favorite colors!

213.TextAdd: 角色扮演-完成1次自拍模式拍照
213.Tips: Camera offers four modes: Normal, Selfie, Combat, and Motion. Record the moment!

214.Describe: Participate in a multiplayer photo session 1 time
214.TextAdd: 角色扮演-参与1次多人拍照
214.Tips: After entering Camera mode, tap the Player+ button to invite Friends, Guild members, and Team members to take a photo together. You can even edit each adventurer's emote individually!

215.TextAdd: 角色扮演-完成1次战斗模式拍照
215.Tips: Camera offers four modes: Normal, Selfie, Combat, and Motion. Record the moment!

216.Describe: Chat in World or Guild Channel once
216.TextAdd: 角色扮演-在世界频道或协会频道发言1次

217.Tips: If you want to change your look, hairstyle, or body shape, go to the Beauty Center!

218.Tips: If you want to change your look, hairstyle, or body shape, go to the Beauty Center!

219.Describe: Edit and save Photo Wall in Personal Space once
219.TextAdd: 角色扮演-编辑并保存一次个人空间的照片墙
219.Tips: Share your latest beautiful photos with everyone!

220.Tips: In Life Skills activities, some gathering targets and crafting targets cost Focus. In addition to earning tradable items, you will also gain a large amount of Life Skills EXP. 400 Focus auto-recovers daily at 05:00 (UTC-2), subject to the max Focus limit of 2,000.

221.Describe: Earn some Luno through the Trading Center
221.TextAdd: 模拟经营-经营交易所赚取卢诺
221.Tips: The Trading Center allows you to sell specific items. The number of listed items is limited, and prices can be adjusted within a specific range.

222.TextAdd: 模拟经营-进行{*val*}次协会货运赚取卢诺
222.Tips: Join a Guild and take on cargo quests at the Guild Center to obtain Luno and Guild Tokens!

223.TextAdd: 模拟经营-完成{*val*}个家园订单
223.Tips: The Homestead Traveling Merchant has 3 commissions daily, which require buying specific items or materials. Completing them grants Homestead EXP and Homestead Coins. Up to 3 commissions may be submitted per day, with unused submissions eligible for rollover to subsequent days, not exceeding a maximum of 9 stored submissions.

224.Tips: Use the Crafting Station to make furniture. Some furniture requires unlocking the crafting recipe first. The Crafting Station starts with 4 slots. The more adventurers share the homestead, the more slots will become available!

225.Tips: Find fishing spots on the map to fish. Fish species vary by region. Catching a fish species unlocks its Fish Guide. Caught fish can be used for research. Using the same type of fish increases research speed. As progress grows, the fish's research level increases, unlocking boosts that enhance your fishing performance.

226.Tips: After unlocking Homestead, gain land by leveling up Homestead or by purchasing. Used for planting flowers. Hybridizing flowers yields different traits. Rarer flowers sell for more!

227.Tips: After unlocking Homestead, gain land by leveling up Homestead or by purchasing. Used for planting flowers. Hybridizing flowers yields different traits. Rarer flowers sell for more!

228.TextAdd: 休闲探索-在空中飞行超过10秒
228.Tips: Float & Glide: With the mastery of wind, you can float in the air and fall slowly. Switch to Glide while floating to travel faster. Go to Asterleeds Plains - Ancient City of Vill, find the Hero's Herb, and resonate with it to get the Terra Resonance Skill: Float & Glide. Equip in Skills/Terra Resonance to use it.

229.TextAdd: 休闲探索-打开{*val*}个大世界宝箱
229.Tips: Gifts granted to adventurers on their journey. Open them to receive generous rewards. Explore the world actively to uncover their whereabouts!

230.TextAdd: 休闲探索-完成{*val*}个粒子收集挑战
230.Tips: You'll find Storm Particles scattered throughout the world. Touching one will trigger a particle collection quest.

231.TextAdd: 休闲探索-击破{*val*}个风屏障
231.Tips: Phantom Dash: Rapidly dash forward a certain distance, allowing a second dash within a certain time. It has super-strong burst power that can break through the wind barrier in the plains. Go to Asterleeds Plains, use the wind tunnel beside the Andra Resting Post to reach the top of the floating island, find the Wind Core, and resonate with it to get the Terra Resonance Skill: Phantom Dash. Equip in Skills/Terra Resonance to use it.

232.Describe: Defeat Golden Nappo or Silver Nappo {*val*} time(s)
232.TextAdd: 休闲探索-参与击败{*val*}次“娜宝·闪闪”或“娜宝·银辉”
232.Tips: Magical Creatures appear from time to time in the wild. Defeat them to get headwear, custom mount skins, toys, etc. Check Monster Hunt - Magical Creature tab for details.

233.Describe: Defeat Lovely Boarlet, Breezy Boarlet, or Loyal Boarlet {*val*} time(s)
233.TextAdd: 休闲探索-参与击败{*val*}次“小猪·爱”、“小猪·风”或“小猪·闪闪”
233.Tips: Magical Creatures appear from time to time in the wild. Defeat them to get headwear, custom mount skins, toys, etc. Check Monster Hunt - Magical Creature tab for details.

234.TextAdd: 休闲探索-参加1次“环城坐骑赛”
234.Tips: The first participation each day grants massive Friendship Points. Repeated participation grants small amounts only. The weekly limit for acquiring Friendship Points is 2,000. You can use the points in Friendship to redeem Outfits, Emotes, and other exclusive rewards. City Rally is open for a limited time weekly. Check details for more.

235.TextAdd: 休闲探索-参加1次“废都障碍赛”
235.Tips: The first participation each day grants massive Friendship Points. Repeated participation grants small amounts only. The weekly limit for acquiring Friendship Points is 2,000. You can use the points in Friendship to redeem Outfits, Emotes, and other exclusive rewards. Wasteland Race is open for a limited time weekly. Check details for more.

236.TextAdd: 休闲探索-参加1次“气球捕获大作战”
236.Tips: The first participation each day grants massive Friendship Points. Repeated participation grants small amounts only. The weekly limit for acquiring Friendship Points is 2,000. You can use the points in Friendship to redeem Outfits, Emotes, and other exclusive rewards. Balloon Capture is open for a limited time weekly. Check details for more.

237.Describe: Participate in "Ee-chan, don't stare at me!" once
237.TextAdd: 休闲探索-参加1次“小伊别盯我！”
237.Tips: The first participation each day grants massive Friendship Points. Repeated participation grants small amounts only. The weekly limit for acquiring Friendship Points is 2,000. You can use the points in Friendship to redeem Outfits, Emotes, and other exclusive rewards. "Ee-chan, Don't Stare at Me!" is open for a limited time weekly. Check details for more.

238.Describe: Earn {*val*} points in the Hotspot Event
238.TextAdd: 休闲探索-在泡点玩法中累计获得{*val*}分
238.Tips: Participating in Idle Casual mode is one way to get Friendship Points. The first participation each day in different casual activities grants massive Friendship Points. Repeated participation grants small amounts only. The weekly limit for acquiring Friendship Points is 2,000. You can use the points in Friendship to redeem Outfits, Emotes, and other exclusive rewards. Idle Casual mode is open for a limited time weekly. Check details for more.

239.TextAdd: 休闲探索-完成{*val*}轮调查委托
239.Tips: Pioneer Bureau posts multiple quests daily. This is an important source of Honor Coins! Supports solo or team completion. Commissions can be accumulated for up to 3 days.

401.QuickJumpIdText: 试炼之路、天赋历练任务、生体元等级
401.Tips: Each class has its own Talent Tree. Talent Points are used to activate nodes in the Talent Tree to obtain stat effects, passive effects, or special skill effects. The Recommended Build feature allows for quick allocation based on system recommendations. Talent Points can be obtained in the following ways.

402.Tips: Each class has its own Talent Tree, which switches when you change classes. Each Talent Tree has several nodes, including stat effects, passive effects, and special skill effects. Consuming Talent Points activates these nodes (some nodes also consume Arcane Seals). Using the Recommended Build feature allows for quick allocation based on system recommendations.

406.Tips: Adventurers can equip gear suitable for their class/style to boost combat power. There are 11 slots for gear. You can equip, unequip, or replace gear in the Gear interface. Gear can be obtained in the following ways.

408.Tips: Refinement is one way to upgrade gear. Go to Maxim at the Artisan Guild for refinement. When replacing gear of the same slot, refinement will be transferred automatically for free. Gear refinement materials are obtainable via:

410.Describe: Obtain {*val*} Stunt or Arcane Will(s) via <color=#fcbe03>Monster Hunt or Exchange</color>
410.QuickJumpIdText: 补偿商店、怪物讨伐、司第门遗迹、幻想研究所兑换、交易中心
410.TextAdd: 进阶-幻想获得紫色或以上
410.Tips: Will is the core item for crafting Battle Imagines. Successfully crafting a Battle Imagine activates the corresponding Battle Imagine Skill. This is a powerful combat support skill, where each skill includes 1 active skill and a passive effect. Adventurers can mix and match based on their class and environment. Up to 2 skills can be equipped at the same time. Materials can be obtained in the following ways.

411.Describe: Go to the <color=#fcbe03>Imagine Research Institute</color> to craft {*val*} Stunt or Arcane Battle Imagines
411.TextAdd: 进阶-幻想制作紫色或以上
411.Tips:
Crafting Battle Imagines requires the corresponding Battle Will and other materials. Collect resources and go to the Imagine Research Institute to craft.
Materials can be obtained via Monster Hunt, Stimen Vaults, Imagine Research Institute Exchange, etc.

412.TextAdd: 进阶-幻想升阶紫色或以上
412.Tips:
Upgrading enhances the active and passive effects of Battle Imagine Skills. Upgrading requires the corresponding Battle Will and materials. Collect resources and go to the Battle Imagine page to cultivate.
Materials can be obtained via Monster Hunt, Stimen Vaults, Imagine Research Institute Exchange, etc.
